title_en: Regulations on Energy Conservation in Public Institutions

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the Energy Conservation Law of the People's Republic of China for the purposes of promoting energy conservation in public institutions, improving the efficiency of energy utilization in public institutions, and giving play to the exemplary role of public institutions in energy conservation throughout society.
Article 2 For the purposes of these Regulations, "public institutions" means state organs, public institutions and organizations that use fiscal funds in whole or in part.

Article 3 Public institutions shall strengthen energy management, adopt technically feasible and economically reasonable measures to reduce energy consumption, reduce and stop energy waste, and utilize energy effectively and reasonably.

Article 4 The department in charge of energy conservation under the State Council shall be in charge of the supervision and administration of energy conservation in public institutions nationwide. The administrative institution of government offices under the State Council shall, under the guidance of the department in charge of energy conservation under the State Council, be responsible for promoting, guiding, coordinating and supervising the national energy conservation work of public institutions.
The administrative institution of government offices under the State Council and under the local people's governments at or above the county level shall, under the guidance of the department in charge of energy conservation at the same level, be responsible for the supervision and administration of energy conservation in public institutions at the corresponding level.
The competent departments at all levels in the fields of education, science and technology, culture, health, sports, etc., shall, under the guidance of the administrative institution of government offices at the same level, carry out energy conservation work in public institutions within their respective systems.

Article 5 The administrative institution of government offices under the State Council and under the local people's governments at or above the county level shall, together with the relevant departments at the same level, carry out publicity, education and training on energy conservation in public institutions, and popularize scientific knowledge on energy conservation.

Article 6 The person in charge of a public institution shall be fully responsible for the energy conservation work of the institution.
The energy conservation work of public institutions shall implement a target responsibility system and an examination and evaluation system, and the completion of energy conservation targets shall be taken as part of the content for the examination and evaluation of the persons in charge of public institutions.

Article 7 Public institutions shall establish and improve the rules and regulations for energy management of the institution, carry out energy conservation publicity, education and job training, enhance the awareness of energy conservation of the staff, cultivate energy conservation habits, and improve the level of energy management.

Article 8 The energy conservation work of public institutions shall be subject to social supervision. Any unit or individual shall have the right to report the act of wasting energy by public institutions, and the relevant department shall promptly investigate and handle the report.

Article 9 Units and individuals that have made outstanding achievements in the energy conservation work of public institutions shall be commended and rewarded in accordance with the provisions of the State.

Article 10 The administrative institution of government offices under the State Council and under the local people's governments at or above the county level shall, together with the relevant departments at the same level, formulate the energy conservation plan for public institutions at the corresponding level in accordance with the medium-term and long-term special plan for energy conservation of the people's government at the same level.
The energy conservation plan for public institutions at the county level shall include the content of energy conservation of public institutions in the townships (towns) under its jurisdiction.

The energy conservation plan of a public institution shall include such aspects as guiding ideology and principles, current energy consumption status and problems, energy conservation targets and indicators, key energy conservation links, implementation subjects, and safeguard measures.

The organs for the administration of government offices under the State Council and the local people's governments at or above the county level shall break down the energy conservation targets and indicators determined in the energy conservation plan of public institutions and allocate them to the public institutions at the same level on an annual basis.

A public institution shall, based on its own energy consumption characteristics and the energy consumption status of the previous year, formulate annual energy conservation targets and implementation plans, and take targeted energy conservation management or energy conservation renovation measures to ensure the achievement of the energy conservation targets.
A public institution shall report its annual energy conservation targets and implementation plans to the organ for the administration of government offices under the people's government at the same level for archival filing.

A public institution shall implement an energy consumption metering system, differentiate energy consumption types and energy consumption systems, and carry out household, category, and itemized metering of energy consumption, and conduct real-time monitoring of energy consumption status to promptly detect and correct energy waste.

A public institution shall designate a specific person to be responsible for energy consumption statistics, faithfully record the original data of energy consumption metering, and establish a statistical ledger.
A public institution shall, before March 31 of each year, submit a report on the energy consumption status of the previous year to the organ for the administration of government offices under the people's government at the same level.

The organs for the administration of government offices under the State Council and the local people's governments at or above the county level shall, together with the relevant departments at the same level and within their respective administrative authority, formulate energy consumption quotas based on the comprehensive levels and characteristics of energy consumption of public institutions in different industries and systems, and the financial departments shall formulate energy consumption expenditure standards based on the energy consumption quotas.

A public institution shall use energy within the energy consumption quotas and strengthen the management of energy consumption expenditure; where it uses energy exceeding the energy consumption quotas, it shall provide an explanation to the organ for the administration of government offices under the people's government at the same level.

A public institution shall, in accordance with the state provisions on mandatory procurement or priority procurement, purchase products and equipment included in the government procurement list of energy-saving products and equipment and the government procurement list of environmental labeling products, and shall not purchase energy-consuming products and equipment that are explicitly eliminated by the state.

The government procurement supervision and administration departments under the State Council and the provincial people's governments shall, together with the relevant departments at the same level, improve the government procurement list of energy-saving products and equipment, and give priority to including products and equipment that have obtained energy-saving product certification certificates in the government procurement list.
The State Council and the provincial people's governments shall incorporate the products and equipment in the government procurement list of energy-saving products and equipment into the centralized government procurement catalog.

New buildings and renovation of existing buildings of public institutions shall strictly implement the state provisions and standards on building energy conservation design, construction, commissioning, and completion acceptance, and the construction administrative departments under the State Council and the local people's governments at or above the county level shall strengthen supervision and inspection on the implementation of the relevant state provisions and standards.
The departments responsible for approving fixed asset investment projects under the State Council and the local people's governments at or above the county level shall strictly control the construction scale and standards of public institution projects, make overall consideration of energy conservation investment and benefits, conduct energy conservation assessment and review of construction projects, and projects that fail to pass the energy conservation assessment and review shall not commence construction; for government-invested projects that fail to pass the energy conservation assessment and review, the departments responsible for project approval according to law shall not approve the construction.

Article 21 The State Council and the administrative department for government office affairs of local people's governments at or above the county level shall, jointly with the relevant departments, formulate the energy-saving renovation plan for existing buildings of public institutions at the corresponding level and organize its implementation.

Article 22 A public institution shall, according to the provisions, conduct an energy audit, assess the operation and energy use of its energy-using systems and equipment from a technical and economic perspective, and take measures to improve energy efficiency based on the audit results. The specific measures shall be formulated by the department of the State Council in charge of energy conservation jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council.

Article 24 A public institution shall establish and improve its energy-saving operation management system and operating procedures for energy-using systems, strengthen the operation adjustment, maintenance, and inspection of energy-using systems and equipment, and promote low-cost and no-cost energy-saving measures.

Article 25 A public institution shall set up an energy management position and implement a responsibility system for the energy management position. The operating positions of key energy-using systems and equipment shall be staffed with professional technical personnel.

Article 26 A public institution may adopt the contract energy management method to entrust an energy-saving service institution with energy-saving diagnosis, design, financing, renovation, and operation management.

Article 27 A public institution shall, when selecting a property service enterprise, consider its energy-saving management capability. A property service contract concluded between a public institution and a property service enterprise shall specify the objectives and requirements for energy-saving management.

Article 28 A public institution shall, when implementing energy-saving renovation, conduct an energy audit and an investment return analysis, specify energy-saving indicators, and after the energy-saving renovation, use measurement methods to assess and comprehensively evaluate the energy-saving indicators.

Article 29 A public institution shall reduce the standby energy consumption of electrical equipment such as air conditioners, computers, and photocopiers, and promptly turn off such equipment when not in use.

Article 30 A public institution shall strictly implement the provisions of the State on indoor temperature control of air conditioners, make full use of natural ventilation, and improve the operation management of air conditioners.

Article 31 The elevator systems of public institutions shall implement intelligent control, reasonably set the number and time of elevator operation, and strengthen operation adjustment and maintenance.

Article 32 The office buildings of public institutions shall make full use of natural lighting, use high-efficiency energy-saving lighting fixtures, optimize lighting system design, improve circuit control methods, promote the application of intelligent control devices, and strictly control external flood lighting and external decorative lighting of buildings.

Article 33 Public institutions shall implement key monitoring of energy consumption in areas such as network equipment rooms, canteens, boiling water rooms, and boiler rooms, and take effective measures to reduce energy consumption.

Article 34 Official vehicles of public institutions shall be equipped according to standards, with priority given to vehicles with low energy consumption, low pollution, and using clean energy, and the vehicle scrapping system shall be strictly implemented.
Public institutions shall use official vehicles for the prescribed purposes, formulate energy-saving driving norms, and implement a single-vehicle energy consumption accounting system.
Public institutions shall actively promote the socialization of official vehicle services and encourage staff to use public transport and non-motorized vehicles for travel.

Article 36 Public institutions shall cooperate with energy conservation supervision and inspection, truthfully explain the relevant circumstances, and provide relevant materials and data, and shall not refuse or obstruct.

Article 38 Where a public institution fails to implement the government procurement list of energy-saving products and equipment, fails to procure products or equipment on the government procurement list of energy-saving products and equipment in accordance with the state's provisions on mandatory procurement or preferential procurement, or procures energy-consuming products or equipment that are expressly eliminated by the state, the government procurement supervision and administration department shall give it a warning and may impose a fine; the persons directly in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given sanctions according to law and be circulated as a notice.

Article 39 Where the department responsible for approving fixed asset investment projects approves a construction project of a public institution that has not passed the energy conservation assessment and review, the persons directly in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given sanctions according to law.
Where a public institution starts construction of a construction project that has not passed the energy conservation assessment and review, the relevant organ shall order it to make rectification within a time limit according to law; the persons directly in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given sanctions according to law.

Article 40 Where a public institution, in violation of the provisions, purchases official vehicles in excess of the standards or authorized number, or refuses to scrap vehicles with high energy consumption and high pollution, the persons directly in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given sanctions according to law, and the department in charge of government office affairs of the people's government at the same level shall, in accordance with the relevant provisions, handle the vehicles by means such as recovery, auction, or ordering return.

Article 41 Where a public institution uses energy in violation of regulations and causes energy waste, the institution in charge of government office affairs of the people's government at the same level shall, jointly with relevant departments, issue an energy conservation rectification opinion letter, and the public institution shall implement it in a timely manner.

Article 42 Where any staff member of the institution in charge of government office affairs abuses his or her powers, neglects his or her duties, or engages in malpractices for personal gain in the supervision and administration of energy conservation of public institutions, if the act constitutes a crime, the criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, sanctions shall be given according to law.
Article 43 These Regulations shall come into force as of October 1, 2008.
